project.name: Enterprise Frontend Renewal
project.context: Hybrid full-stack product with enterprise dashboard, admin workflows, and public-facing pages
project.theme: Clean light enterprise, preserving current brand colors while increasing hierarchy and usability
project.backend_constraint: Do not modify FastAPI routes, schemas, auth behavior, API contracts, or persistence
project.implementation_note: The repository currently uses React TypeScript files (.tsx/.ts), despite the request mentioning .js. Follow the existing repository conventions; if adding JavaScript, use .js only for utility files and preserve API behavior.

primary_tasks: recover from loading and error states
understand product value on public pages
success_actions: complete a workflow without leaving context
find a record in under 10 seconds
understand current system status at a glance
convert qualified visitors to demo/contact actions
discovery.emotional_tone: calm authority, precise, trustworthy, quietly distinctive
design_fusion: subtle paper/grain texture for human warmth
break_patterns: Use asymmetric hero and dashboard compositions rather than centered templates to create a stronger identity
Use color only for status and action so the interface remains calm
Use a serif display voice on public pages and a practical humanist sans in product surfaces

descriptors: tables as operational source of truth
bulk action bar only after selection
side-sheet detail instead of context loss

research.decision: Use dense but breathable product screens and an editorial public layer; avoid generic SaaS gradients and over-cardization.

heading.usage: Public page H1-H2, key empty-state moments; tracking-tight, leading-none

ui.usage: Navigation, forms, tables, buttons, dashboard headings

data.usage: IDs, timestamps, numeric metrics, status codes

rules: Never use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for headings
Keep headings tight and body copy leading-relaxed
Do not use oversized text beyond text-6xl
Use tabular numerals for quantitative columns

colors.archetype: Swiss & high-contrast with warm paper tint
usage: Primary only for CTA, selected navigation, links, and focus
Accent reserved for notable editorial highlights
Status colors always include text/icon/label, never color alone
colors.contrast: Meet WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text and controls; never use pure black or pure gray.

visual_enhancers.texture: Use a nearly invisible warm grain/noise overlay on public sections only; aria-hidden=true and opacity below 0.04
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat white panels with 1px tinted borders; use subtle ambient shadows only for overlays and elevated actions
visual_enhancers.header: Solid or bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-xl with border-b; never fully transparent
visual_enhancers.scrollbar: Customize to a slim tinted scrollbar without layout gutter
visual_enhancers.icons: Use the existing icon system or lucide-react; no emoji icons

component_name.app_shell: Persistent desktop sidebar + compact mobile header/bottom navigation
component_name.page_header: Breadcrumb, title, description, primary action, optional contextual tools
component_name.kpi_strip: Three to six summary metrics with trend, timestamp, and semantic status
component_name.data_table: Toolbar, filter chips, sticky header, selectable rows, pagination, empty/loading/error variants
component_name.detail_sheet: Side panel for row details and secondary actions without losing table context
component_name.form_section: Grouped labels, helper/error text, explicit required markers, submit and cancel actions
component_name.status_badge: Text plus icon plus color; never color-only
component_name.toast: Sonner notifications for save, failure, undo, and background completion
component_name.public_proof_band: Editorial trust stats, customer proof, security/compliance content

component_path.convention: Prefer existing components and route patterns. Do not create a parallel frontend or alter backend files.

grids.dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6 items-start
grids.marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12; intentionally leave breathing cells
grids.table: Full-width dense layout; toolbar and table are direct children of the page flow; no animated wrapper that breaks grid alignment
grids.spacing: Use p-6/p-8 inside bordered surfaces and py-16/py-24 between major sections.

admin: toolbar with search, filters, saved view, density, export
public: visible glass/solid nav with logo, 3-5 links, CTA
feature detail with product UI close-up
dark contrast footer with massive brand element
mobile: collapse sidebar to reachable bottom nav or drawer
use horizontal table scroll with visible affordance

interactions: staggered entrance for lists at 30-50ms intervals
loading skeleton shimmer only while waiting
motion.reduced_motion: Wrap nonessential animation in prefers-reduced-motion; preserve instant state changes and focus visibility. Never use transition: all.

requirements: Every interactive and key informational element gets a stable kebab-case data-testid
Use semantic buttons/links and labels, not clickable divs
Keyboard-navigable filters, sort controls, menus, dialogs, and tables
Use aria-live for save/error/filter result announcements
Do not rely on hover-only actions
Destructive actions require confirmation and offer undo where possible

media.strategy: No external imagery is required for the dashboard. Public pages may use product screenshots or real customer imagery only when available; do not use placeholder URLs.
rules: Prefer close-up product UI crops over generic stock photos
Maintain visible subject through overlays; never exceed bg-black/50

3d libraries.decision: Not needed: enterprise workflows prioritize clarity and performance
steps: Do not add 3D unless a validated product story requires immersion
If later added, lazy-load via Suspense and preserve keyboard/fallback content

general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: Keep current backend and API integration unchanged
Preserve current colors as semantic roles, then normalize them through tokens
Avoid generic centered layouts, full-screen gradients, and uniform cards
Use cardless rectangular table surfaces and max 8px radius for admin
Every form needs helper, validation, loading, success, and error states
Every async action needs disabled/loading feedback and Sonner confirmation
Never use transparent backgrounds behind content; use solid or blurred surfaces
Prefer progressive disclosure and side sheets to route users away from context
Maintain responsive behavior at mobile, tablet, desktop, and wide desktop
Use precise button labels that describe the action, not vague words like Continue
instructions_to_main_agent: Read and preserve existing route, auth, API, and test contracts before editing
Implement in the existing /app/web React app and existing style files
Audit every existing screen, then apply shared shell, page header, table, form, button, loading, error, and empty-state patterns consistently
Use Shadcn primitives where already present or needed for advanced interactions; customize them to this visual system
Add data-testid to all interactive and key informational elements
Run the existing test suite and build after frontend changes; do not touch backend
If an API or flow is not working, surface the real error state rather than mocking it. Do not introduce MOCKED integrations or placeholder data in production flows.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Create distinctive, enterprise-grade frontend work with generous spacing, layered depth, restrained color, explicit interaction states, accessible semantics, and no AI-slop gradients or emoji icons.
